title: bound loop_state growth: beta_findings/note accumulation is the residual R10 pattern one level down
description: TASK-103 review LOW-2 (rev-103, 2026-07-07, T1 evidence). bundleStateSchema leaves loop_state free-form (additionalProperties: true); the live loop_state.beta_findings array has accumulated ~8KB of prose across drives and loop_state.note ~1.5KB, with no cap and no rotation — the same unbounded-growth pattern TASK-103 fixed for decisions/subagent_results, one level down. session.json remains 94KB post-compaction largely due to this plus the long handoff_summary. Scope: either cap loop_state fields in the schema (maxLength/maxItems with a compaction path for beta_findings, e.g. rotate into the TASK-103 archive.jsonl with a type tag) or document+sensor a bound. Coordinate with the TASK-103 mechanism rather than inventing a second archive.
acceptance_criteria: loop_state.beta_findings and loop_state.note have an enforced bound (schema cap or fast-tier sensor) that fails red against a synthetic oversized loop_state — red-first spec.
An overflow path exists that preserves content (rotation into the existing bundle archive with a type tag, or equivalent) — no data loss, append-only.
The live bundle's current beta_findings are rotated once via the new path on the record; resume-point/get-mode verified intact afterwards.
Docs: the TASK-103 compaction sections (both SKILL.md copies + state/README.md) gain the loop_state bound — existing doc-lock spec extended, not duplicated.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
CLOSED on green review. Reviewer verdict APPROVE (review_depth=full; rubric inputs: bundle STATE-SCHEMA change — loop_state maxItems/maxLength caps; new lossless rotation path on append-only archive.jsonl; moderate multi-surface diff schema+compaction+loop-ctl CLI+docs+dist). 0 HIGH / 0 MEDIUM / 2 LOW (no CLI e2e for --max-note-length — module-level covered, flag handling byte-identical to tested --max-beta-findings, reviewer ruled optional-not-warranted; commit not formatted as explicit 5-item checklist but all items covered in substance). Clean first-pass, no RC loop — no knowledge draft.

Implementation (commit 712edb6, tdd single-commit): loop_state.beta_findings gets maxItems:15, loop_state.note gets maxLength:4000 in src/schemas.js + state/bundle.schema.json (additionalProperties:true preserved so other loop_state keys stay free-form). New partitionArrayTail + compactLoopState (pure) in src/bundle-compaction.js; appendBundleArchive EXTENDED IN PLACE (same archive.jsonl, two new type tags loop_state_beta_finding/loop_state_note) and compactBundleSession extended — coordinates with the TASK-103 mechanism, no second archive (explicit AC, reviewer-confirmed via git grep: exactly one archive writer). Crash-safe ordering verified: archive-append precedes in-bundle trim, so a crash leaves duplicates (recoverable) never data loss; append-only via appendFileSync. Resume counters (current_ticket/phase/iteration/completed_this_run/run_started_at) provably untouched. AC3 (rotate live bundle once) vacuously N/A and honest — reviewer independently confirmed the live bundle's loop_state has no beta_findings/note key. loop-ctl compact-bundle gains --max-beta-findings/--max-note-length flags. dist/init.cjs + dist/loop-ctl.cjs rebuilt+committed, dist-parity green. Docs: state/README.md + orchestrator-routing SKILL.md (both parity copies) compaction section extended (doc-lock extended not duplicated). Gate: test:all 1809 passed / 4 skip; reviewer re-ran test:since -- 21e18ea (146) + fast tier (983) + named e2e (55), all green.
